input:
We’ve already reprocessed the documents twice but the reserves still aren’t updating in the reporting tab.
Reserves are not updating in the reporting tab despite reprocessing documents.

The lack of real-time visibility into garage progress is forcing us to chase manually... when someone’s out and a reserve goes over limit, it just sits there — no backup, no movement.
The platform lacks real-time visibility into garage progress and fails to automatically handle reserve limit breaches when users are unavailable.

We’ve seen the same loss reported through two channels — phone and web — and no system warning appeared, creating a duplicate loss report that complicates our reserves and payments.
The system fails to detect and prevent duplicate loss reports submitted via different channels, leading to data integrity issues.

Just that we’re losing time daily on this — it’s not sustainable without better visibility and planning.
The current platform lacks sufficient visibility and planning features, causing users to waste time daily.

we’ve had a few cases where the system choked on large batches — maybe a bug or limit?
The system fails or slows down when processing large batches of claims.

when we upload garage estimates, they’re landing in the wrong document category—like under Correspondence—and we’re having to manually move them, which risks things slipping through the cracks.
Uploaded garage estimates are automatically categorized incorrectly, requiring manual reassignment and risking missed evidence.

Claim details: click "Save", rage x3
The user is frustrated because the 'Save' action on claim details fails or behaves unexpectedly, requiring multiple attempts.

I’m having trouble accessing the claims module — it’s saying my login credentials aren’t valid.
The user is unable to log in to the claims module due to an invalid credentials error.

the last update moved the ‘reserves’ button — we had to retrain half the team because of that.
A recent update changed the location of the 'reserves' button, causing significant disruption and requiring team retraining.

our finance team’s noticed the report totals differ — they’re comparing dashboard numbers with exported files and getting confused.
The numerical totals in the dashboard reports do not match the data in the exported files, causing confusion for the finance team.

we’re having some trouble navigating the claims module after the last update — things aren’t where we left them.
The user interface layout in the claims module changed unexpectedly after a recent update, making it difficult to navigate.

we’re missing visibility when tasks get stuck or letters go unacknowledged by policyholders.
The platform lacks visibility into tasks that are stuck or letters that have not been acknowledged by policyholders.

the claims dashboard suddenly shifted where the reserves tab sits — no heads-up, no training notes, nothing.
The location of the reserves tab in the claims dashboard changed unexpectedly without prior notice or training.

Our motor team handles hundreds of claims weekly and needs automated routing by postcode and workload — manual claim routing slows them down too much.
The motor team requires automated claim routing based on postcode and workload to handle high volumes, as manual routing is too slow.

We need predictability so our staff don’t have to keep relearning where things are.
The user interface lacks consistency, forcing staff to repeatedly relearn navigation paths.

I’m having trouble logging into Keelwater to upload the policyholder documents for our latest claim.
The customer is unable to log into the Keelwater platform to upload documents.

Tasks: click "Save", rage x3
The user is frustrated and repeatedly clicking the Save button, indicating it may not be working or providing feedback.

I’m trying to upload some policyholder documents for a recent claim but the interface isn’t showing the upload field
The upload field for policyholder documents is missing from the interface, preventing users from attaching files to claims.

Great — we’ll be ready to go live once the upload files together issue is resolved.
The product currently fails to upload files together, preventing the customer from going live.

our commercial claims team needs manual claim routing — auto-assignment breaks our complex cases.
The automatic claim assignment feature is too rigid for complex cases, forcing the team to route claims manually.

Right now, we’re manually cross-checking every new claim to avoid the same claim twice, which eats up time we could spend on supplier coordination or reporting.
The platform lacks an automated duplicate claim detection feature, forcing users to manually cross-check every new claim.

we’re having trouble accessing our reserves dashboard after the update last week.
The customer cannot access the reserves dashboard following a recent system update.

we need a sandbox environment to test fraud detection rules before rolling them out live... We’re risking false positives in production without a safe testing environment.
The platform lacks a sandbox environment for testing fraud detection rules, leading to risks of false positives in production.

It’s messy when the same claim twice comes in — one by phone, one online, and the system doesn’t flag it.
The system fails to automatically detect and flag duplicate claims submitted through different channels.

I need to reset my password for the claims portal as I’m locked out and can’t access documents or reserves.
The user is unable to access the claims portal due to a password lockout, preventing them from viewing documents and reserves.

We need letters in Welsh for policyholders — it’s not just a nice-to-have, it’s tied to our renewal terms with Keelwater.
The platform currently lacks support for generating correspondence in Welsh, which is a contractual requirement.

is there a way to lock reporting periods so payments don’t get double-counted?
The user wants to prevent double-counting of payments by locking reporting periods.

We’re still wrestling with how claim progress messages go out — it’s all manual right now and we’re behind on updates, so we’re relying on manual workarounds until automation lands.
The platform lacks automated claim progress messaging, forcing users to send updates manually and causing delays.

I’m trying to reconcile the latest reserves update with the payments we’ve processed for policyholders this week, and the numbers aren’t lining up.
The user is unable to reconcile reserve updates with processed payments because the numbers do not match, indicating a potential data integrity or reporting issue within the platform.

I need to update the supplier details for a couple of claims — can you help me find where that’s managed?
The customer cannot easily locate the interface to update supplier details for existing claims.

any update on when policyholders will start getting those milestone updates automatically?
The system does not currently send automatic milestone updates to policyholders.

How do I upload policyholder documents into the system without triggering a reserve alert?
The user is unsure how to upload policyholder documents without inadvertently triggering a reserve alert.

I’m trying to upload a claim document but the system says I’ve selected the wrong document category — can you help?
The user is unable to upload a claim document because the system incorrectly flags their selected document category as wrong.

Exactly — unexpected interface changes keep shifting where we click for reserves or payments. Our staff are making errors because the controls aren’t where they were last week.
The user interface changes unexpectedly, causing staff to make errors when trying to locate controls for reserves and payments.

When a handler needs to adjust a reserve beyond their limit, it goes into an approval waiting list — but if the approver’s out, nothing moves until they return.
Reserve adjustments are blocked indefinitely when the designated approver is unavailable, with no alternative path for approval.

the same incident came in both by phone and web portal, and now we’ve got two separate claims with no alert to flag it... causing real confusion for our adjusters when reserves and payments get split across two records.
The system fails to detect and alert users when the same incident is reported via multiple channels, resulting in duplicate claims that disrupt financial reserves and adjuster workflows.

When a reserve exceeds authority and the approver’s out with no delegate, it just piles up — that approval waiting list causes unnecessary delays... it’s claims stalling until someone returns.
The system lacks an automatic fallback or delegation mechanism when a reserve exceeds authority and the designated approver is unavailable, causing claims to stall.

We’ve had some trouble recently with attaching multiple files to claims — it’s been clunky.
The process for attaching multiple files to a claim is difficult and inefficient.

I need to reset my password for the Keelwater portal because I can’t access my account to upload claims documents.
The user is unable to access their account to upload claims documents due to a forgotten password.

I need to reset my password for the claims portal — it’s not letting me in even though I’m sure I’m typing it right.
The user is unable to log in to the claims portal despite entering the correct password.

we’re having trouble pulling the latest payments report for our policyholders, and it’s holding up our month-end close.
The system is failing to generate the latest payments report, causing delays in month-end financial closing.

We’re really pushing for automatic claim progress messages to go out via SMS and email to policyholders at each milestone — it’s a big gap for us right now.
The platform currently lacks automatic SMS and email notifications to policyholders at claim milestones.

reserve changes are waiting for an approver who’s on leave — no delegate set up. Claims are stalled because reserve changes beyond handler authority are stuck in an approver’s queue with no backup
Reserve changes exceeding handler authority are stalled because the system lacks a delegation feature for approvers who are on leave.

It’s the MI dashboard versus the CSV export. The numbers don’t line up, and finance is questioning which one to trust.
The data displayed in the MI dashboard does not match the data in the CSV export, causing trust issues with financial reporting.

we’re still manually calling garages because the system doesn’t show live repair updates, which eats up half our morning.
The platform lacks live repair updates, forcing users to manually contact garages.

we’ve got policyholders waiting on letters, and tasks are piling up because the reporting module’s stuck.
The reporting module is stuck, causing tasks to pile up and delaying letters for policyholders.

Every time we upload a garage estimate, it lands in correspondence — it’s a wrong document category and handlers keep missing key evidence because of it, which delays claims resolution.
Uploaded garage estimates are incorrectly categorized as correspondence, causing handlers to miss evidence and delaying claims.

I’m still waiting on those automatic claim progress messages for policyholders — we were told Q1 next year, but it’s dragging and handlers are fielding repeat calls.
The automatic claim progress messaging feature for policyholders is delayed, causing handlers to receive excessive repeat calls.

dashboard totals don’t match what they export, and they’re worried the numbers aren’t reliable for reporting.
The dashboard totals do not match the exported data, causing confusion and concerns about reliability for financial reporting.

Your last update moved some controls without warning. Our teams had to retrain because of unexpected interface changes — and we’re still seeing errors from it.
The platform's recent update unexpectedly moved interface controls, causing user errors and requiring staff retraining.

we’ve had to retrain our claims team twice in three months because of unannounced screen changes. It’s disruptive and costly... we need more notice before interface updates.
The customer is frustrated by frequent, unannounced interface changes that require repeated retraining of their claims team.

any update on the reserve calculation logic? We need it aligned with our reporting standards.
The reserve calculation logic in the platform does not align with the customer's internal reporting standards.

We’ve got a few things gumming up the works — let’s start with how claims get logged.
The process for logging claims is inefficient or problematic.

We’re also struggling with supplier comms and task tracking — it’s all tied together.
The customer finds it difficult to manage supplier communications and task tracking because these functions are not integrated or distinct enough in the current workflow.

we’d really appreciate fewer surprises and more notice before any major shifts in how we access claims or documents.
The customer is frustrated by unexpected changes to how they access claims and documents without prior warning.

Payments: click "Overview", dead x1
The 'Overview' button in the Payments section is non-functional or broken.

I need to reset my password for the Keelwater portal — I’ve forgotten it and can’t log in to review claims or update reserves.
The user cannot access the portal to perform claim tasks because they forgot their password and need a reset.

the system doesn’t flag it as a potential duplicate. We end up with two separate claims for the same event, which complicates reserves and payments.
The system fails to identify duplicate claims when a policyholder reports the same loss via both phone and web portal.

Reports: click "Export CSV", error exception
The user encounters an error exception when attempting to export reports as CSV.

we’re still waiting on the document upload permissions for our policyholders’ claims portal
The customer is unable to upload documents because the necessary permissions for the policyholders' claims portal have not been granted.

We’ll tweak the monitor settings for now and wait for updates on dark mode.
The customer is waiting for a dark mode feature to be added to the platform.

our finance team’s noticed the report totals differ — they’re comparing dashboard numbers with exported files and getting confused.
The financial totals displayed on the dashboard do not match the data in exported files, causing confusion for the finance team.

can we turn off auto-routing for our commercial claims? They’re too complex.
The user wants to disable automatic routing for commercial claims because the current auto-routing is unsuitable for complex cases.

I’m trying to update our team’s access levels and I’m stuck on assigning roles for new staff.
The user is unable to assign roles to new staff members while updating team access levels.
